title: Work Needs Better Doors
summary: A door names who it is for, the first move, the terms, and how yes happens.
thesis: An invitation is an interface. Openness without a legible first move transfers the work of entry to the person being invited.

door_parts.name: Who
door_parts.rule: Name the judgment, appetite, or lived knowledge the work actually needs.

door_parts.name: First move
door_parts.rule: Bound the proof without extracting free commercial labor.

door_parts.name: Terms
door_parts.rule: State cash, credit, access, ownership, timing, rights, and uncertainty up front.

door_parts.name: Yes
door_parts.rule: Name the human decider and the response clock.

working_proof.name: Industry Next Work Market
working_proof.claim: The job, first task, accountable organization, and reward rail appear on one public surface.

field_task.title: Repair one broken door
field_task.start_rule: Do not begin before Industry Next confirms the claim.
field_task.deliverable: One public source link and one rewritten door using WHO, FIRST MOVE, TERMS, and YES.
field_task.rights: The contributor retains their work. Industry Next publishes only with written approval and credit.
